en.title: About Crypto Baltics
en.description: Explore crypto communities, conferences and companies in Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania.
en.shortTagline: Crypto communities and events across the Baltics
en.heading: Crypto across the Baltics, in person
en.intro: Find communities, conferences and companies in Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania. This local content preview uses the shared site engine; visual identity comes next.
en.contributeText: Suggest a local community, event or correction.

sections.heading: Explore the ecosystem
paragraphs: Start with the sourced directory of communities, companies and conferences. Older groups and uncertain dates are marked separately.

sections.heading: Know what the map shows
paragraphs: The inherited map currently shows Bitcoin-accepting places from BTC Map. It does not assert acceptance of Solana, Monero or other assets.

sections.heading: Local communities, independent voices
paragraphs: Groups retain their own identities. A directory listing does not imply a partnership or endorsement.

sections.heading: Built on a shared foundation
paragraphs: This draft reuses the Bitcoin Baltics interface. The logo, colours and final domain have not yet been chosen.
